_source: The owners' own pairings for „Past erbij” / „Merge cu” (docs/assistant.md §13.4; D-65 point 2). Georgiana's words: FACTS.md „Owners' answers — WhatsApp 10.11.2026” [OWNER]. basis: owner = her word · data = from site/src/data · inferred = Cowork by logic on Dan's instruction 10.11 15:36, the owners can correct. `show` = product ids drawn as cards; the product ids behind her words are Cowork's reading (carnati → braadworst, ceafa → spiering, piept de porc → spek, cote a los → cote-a-los-rund, frigarui → the brochettes, oaie → lam). `text` is said only where there is no card to draw. Cowork 10.11.2026; input for build-plan row 11d. cards_under_bank = the row's cards (the first three of `show`) are also drawn under the bank answer named in `bank` when that answer is given; false = only on the „Past erbij” tap. For a colli the cards come from this week's list without any colli.

text.nl: Erbij: pastasalade, frieten, kroketten of een schotel rauwkost. Te bestellen via WhatsApp.
text.ro: Lângă el: salată de paste, cartofi prăjiți, crochete sau un platou de crudități. Se comandă pe WhatsApp.

text.nl: Erbij: bijgerechten en een goede fles rode, witte of rosé wijn.
text.ro: Lângă ele: garnituri și o sticlă bună de vin roșu, alb sau rosé.

pairings.note: Georgiana gave no pairing for a colli (q4); Dan 10.11: „alte produse care le aveți în magazin”. By logic: the cards come from this week's list (products.json `week`), never the colli itself; drinks are not on file → none. Her tip (freeze what is not eaten in the next days) is the bank answer products-colli-keep, basis owner.
